headline: Season-best ride, seven days out — now bank it
body:
That 36.3 miles with 1,932 feet is your longest and biggest-climbing ride of the season, and it lands in your best climbing week too: 51.3 miles and 2,935 feet, up from 41.9 and 1,798 the week before. The trend is genuinely building. Be clear-eyed about the gap, though. Distance sits 26 miles short of 62, and climbing is the harder shortfall — 1,932 feet across a whole ride is less than Gibraltar's 2,551 in one 6.1-mile push, with the route asking 6,600 total. With seven days left, there's no fitness left to add, only freshness to protect, so the plan is pacing: ride the first 30 miles easy and treat Gibraltar as a long steady grind, not a time trial.

Sunday's 18 mph wind with 28 mph gusts and Monday's 75% rain are rest or trainer days. Tuesday at 71 and calm is your one quality spin with a short foothill climb. Wednesday easy. Thursday and Friday hit 81 and 85 — go early, go short, and stop.
